additional_info.subject: ID0400907-DC/Si-D/DK-[MP / R3 170001652] Lost converter CRM:00642001955
additional_info.body:
Dear Martin,
Hope you are doing great.
Please ensure electrical safety and adhere to PPE guidelines.
As we have received a case from you regarding a lost converter, please find the attached KA link below to troubleshoot the issue.
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_Sicharge_D_Converter_ Missing converter in DC1,DC2,DC3,DC4 - Dynamics 365
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SICD_HW_Power Converter_Missing converters - Dynamics 365
Inspect for any loose connections in the power cables or CAN communication cables of the converter. Measure the voltage across them using a multimeter, and additionally, check the resistance across the CAN communication cables.
Verify the status of the power converter display to see if it is in the OFF or ON state. Consider swapping the power converter with a functional one. If the error flag shifts to the replaced unit, it indicates that the original converter may be faulty. If all the steps have been performed and the power converter is still found to be faulty, we recommend replacing it, as rework is not feasible.
